game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Postern Gate, the hidden postern gate: the squire must handle rogue crows while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Reassign Relay: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before rogue crows can use it.
theme: The Kingdom – Postern Gate: the hidden postern gate
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
player_objective: Protect the market bell from rogue crows in Postern Gate: keep the wave_target meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
lose_condition: wave_target drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 67-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reassign Relay' (Week 1 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Postern Gate'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wave_target changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crows in Postern Gate.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 67 seconds while wave_target > 0.
